answers.answer:
Part (1) passes. DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT (apps/web/convex/ai/transcribe.ts:41) is word for word the same as the Whisper prompt string in both prototypes. I ran an exact-string search with the full text, ending at the closing quote, and it found one match in RoundCompanion_aug21b.html (line 6281, formData.append('prompt', ...)) and one in RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (line 7085). The scripted parity check agrees (verbatim against both). The only thing that differs is the "source :4765" pointer in the code comment: the string sits at line 6281/7085 in these prototype files, not 4765. That is a comment and does not change the hint.

Where the hint goes:
- **Live path:** prepareSession always sends DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT in the realtime transcription session.
- **Batch and recovery path:** transcribeAudio sends args.medicalHint || DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT. No client call passes medicalHint, so every caller gets the same hospital-oriented hint. The callers are:
  - Hospital rounding: AddPatient, quick dictation, PreRoundTab, encounter capture, encounter tasks.
  - Clinic: PreVisitTab, EncounterTab.
  - Nursing Home (SNF): PreRoundTab, encounter dictation.
  - The Ask modal.

There are no per-surface vocabulary prompts. Whether the hospital vocabulary is right for Nursing Home is Q9 and is outside this verdict. Part (2) waits on the EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md copy, which is not under tools/qa-agent/uat/ at this commit.

The hint matches the prototype word for word, so Part (1) passes. DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT in apps/web/convex/ai/transcribe.ts:41 is character-identical to the prompt string in RoundCompanion_aug21b.html:6281 and RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html:7085. I compared them by reading both files, and the scripted parity check agrees (verbatim in both). One small point: the code comment cites 'source :4765', but in these two prototype files the string is at lines 6281 and 7085. The text is still the same.

Who gets the hint: there is a single hint for the whole app, and every transcription path sends it.
- **Live path:** prepareSession always sets transcription.prompt to DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT. Its only caller is src/data/dictation.ts, which passes no arguments.
- **Batch and recovery path:** transcribeAudio sends `args.medicalHint || DEFAULT_MEDICAL_HINT`. No client call site passes medicalHint, so every caller gets the default. The callers are:
  - Hospital rounding: AddPatient, quick dictation, PreRound, encounter capture, encounter tasks
  - Nursing Home: PreRound, encounter dictation
  - Clinic: PreVisit, Encounter
  - AskModal

No per-surface vocabulary prompts exist: nothing in the prompt library or anywhere else supplies a different vocabulary. Using the hospital-oriented vocabulary in Nursing Home is Q9 and is not judged here. Part (2), mapping EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md onto the S01/S02 checks, is a document task the code cannot decide.
